title: Distributed agency in second language learning and teaching through generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and theoretical discussion highlighting how AI models are trained predominantly on white, Western sources, resulting in outputs that default to a "WEIRD" (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) perspective and marginalize non-Western cultures.

Theoretical analysis of how AI tools promote standardized, culturally homogeneous, and monolingual language use, noting empirical examples from cited literature where systems struggle with dialects, regional variability, and accented speech.

Synthesizing existing literature to evaluate how generative AI systems reinforce and reproduce existing social and racial hierarchies, alongside a discussion of the digital divide and inequitable access for underprivileged communities.
